queries.sample_abstract: The octonions are realized as a twisted group algebra of the elementary abelian group of order eight. A sign valued cochain determines multiplication of homogeneous basis elements, and its coboundary measures nonassociativity. Twists and graded equivalences distinguish quaternion, Clifford and octonion algebras with the same group of degrees.

Real Clifford algebras and quaternion algebras can be described as twisted group algebras with signs. A grading by an elementary abelian two group does not determine a unique algebra; square signs, commutation and associator data classify inequivalent multiplications. Split quaternion algebras provide alternatives to division algebras and both can implement complex conjugation by an inner automorphism.
